suggestions.topic: Python GIL Explained: Why Threads Don't Use Multi-Cores
suggestions.rationale: Python developers frequently hit performance ceilings when scaling CPU-bound tasks, making the Global Interpreter Lock one of the most searched core mechanics. Maximizes watch time by debunking common multithreading myths.
suggestions.hook_angle: Why does adding more CPU cores to your Python multithreading script actually make it run slower?

suggestions.topic: LSM Trees vs B-Trees: How Databases Write at Scale
suggestions.rationale: High-throughput database architecture relies on understanding how storage engines handle write amplification. This topic bridges foundational data structures with real-world distributed database performance.
suggestions.hook_angle: B-Trees are great, but why do modern databases like Cassandra and RocksDB use LSM Trees for massive write loads?

suggestions.topic: The Circuit Breaker Pattern in Microservices Architecture
suggestions.rationale: Distributed systems fail unpredictably. The circuit breaker pattern prevents cascading failures across microservices, making it an essential architectural tool for production-ready backend engineering.
suggestions.hook_angle: When one microservice crashes, why does your entire application suddenly go down like a row of dominoes?

suggestions.topic: Bloom Filters in Redis: Stop Checking Empty Database Rows
suggestions.rationale: Engineers scaling cache layers face massive memory overhead when checking for non-existent keys. Bloom filters offer a probabilistic approach that dramatically cuts down expensive database lookups.
suggestions.hook_angle: How can a probabilistic data structure use only a few kilobytes of memory to save your database from millions of dead queries?

suggestions.topic: Strategy Design Pattern in Python: Clean Up Your If-Else Chains
suggestions.rationale: Codebases riddled with massive conditional branches are painful to maintain. Demonstrating the strategy pattern in Python offers an immediate, highly practical refactoring win for developers.
suggestions.hook_angle: Are you tired of maintaining a 500-line if-else statement? Here is how senior devs use the Strategy Pattern to clean it up.

suggestions.topic: Stack vs Heap Memory: Where Does Your Code Live?
suggestions.rationale: Core memory management concepts are a perennial bottleneck for both junior and senior developers debugging segmentation faults, memory leaks, and performance degradation.
suggestions.hook_angle: Stop guessing why your program threw a stack overflow error—let's look at how RAM actually allocates your variables.
